meta.title: Placing an order
meta.description: A shopper places an order: the gateway forwards it, the order service saves it, Payments charges the card, and an event tells the warehouse.

theme.concept: A plain engineering figure: ink on white paper, one accent for what moves.

steps.caption: The web app posts the order, and the gateway passes it to the order service.
The order service saves the order, then asks Payments to charge the card.
It publishes order.placed for the workers and answers the shopper at once.
